verdict.rationale: Paxos documents a public REST API v2.0 with OAuth 2 client-credentials auth, scoped credentials, and endpoint references for transfers, fiat transfers, orders, quotes, and identity onboarding. It also offers FIX and WebSocket APIs and a sandbox that replicates core v2 functionality, so a user or agent can drive the product programmatically end to end. Missing for 10: the probe found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the common paths, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Get market data, create orders, execute held-rate quotes, and transfer assets with Paxos API v2.0.
Paxos APIs use OAuth 2 with the client credentials grant flow.
It includes APIs for market data, orders, and the held rate quote flow.
The Fiat Transfers API allows clients to deposit and withdraw fiat via Wire (Fedwire and SWIFT) and CUBIX networks.
List all transfers, optionally filtering and paging the results.
The Developer Sandbox replicates core v2 API functionality with an automated system that uses test funds to simulate normal activities
